reviews.text: Challenging so far and the combo system is a really fun way to spin card based combat. Haven't even cleared a full run yet but I'd recommend if you're looking to scratch the StS itch.

Seems interesting at first, but becomes extremely boring and makes you realize you can't win right at the 2 hour mark (ironic because now I can't refund.) Definitely doesn't do enough different from other deckbuilders - spend your money on another one and avoid this one unless it's on sale for .99

After finally playing STS and realizing how awesome it was, I went on a serious bender playing anything remotely similar. Man, there is a lot of trash in this genre. But not this game, this one is good. Plays similar to STS with enough differences to have it's own thing happening. Both it's similarities and differences are implemented well. Fair price for what's here with more coming. Recommend.
惊喜的游戏，在一众卡牌肉鸽里做出了自己的特色。特色一，几乎所有卡牌都带combo数值，一张牌需要在连续计数时的第几张打出才可以有关键的加成效果，组牌时也往往需要考虑每种combo数上手概率，看看能不能尽量每回合都能打出0-1-2-3；特色二，所有敌人有跨回合不间断的技能倒计时，有点像时间轴的概念（超舟也有类似机制），就是打出几张牌会触发敌人行动。整体讲就是细到每张牌打什么都会比较关键。

Sure, there're updates at a quick pace and the gameplay is an absolute blast, but I can't really recommend it due to how frustrating it gets 50% of the time. It's not because of the mechanics, tho the learning curve can spike at times, but because of one little thing that's boiled down to 3 words: Remove. Soft. Lock. The game has an odd bug where it locks you out of actions, and you have to hit ESC in order to get yourself out of the soft lock. At first, it was frustrating. Then it became funny. And now it's just sad, because I've found an even worse one. Remove Soft Lock doesn't work 100% of the time. You have to ALT F4 out of the game to get around that particular problem.

I like the game don't get me wrong... BUT I keep running into a problem where it doesn't let me click my cards at all from time to time. Even when I went to the pause menu it wouldn't let me click on the options. For some reason it breaks the ability to click on some of them. I had it happen to me about 5 or 6 different times while I played the game so far. So far that is the only problem I have with the game. So as of now until that bug is fixed I can't recommend this game to anyone.

Another card battler rogue like that can be fun for a time, but then the random chance hits you. Too much reliance on luck to make it far. Didn't get any pets early on? Might as well restart. Got some bad cards added to your deck? Just restart and hope for better luck. That's only fun so many times before you get frustrated that your solid combos don't matter in the face of bad draws and bad events.
Legit not fun. Just no. IDK what i paid for it but it was too much.
目前还在ea阶段，内容太少，只有两种职业，也没有中文。已有的内容玩着感觉还行，要是能一直更新下去并且加上中文的话应该不错。

I generally do not write reviews but this game isn't getting enough visibility for how good/fun it is. I, initially, was not a fan of the combo system but after awhile, you learn ways to work around it; the challenge in that, made it more rewarding. There will be frustrating runs, here and there. And that when you need to learn to pivot your strategy. Overall, it is a good game from an active developer working by himself.
Boring.

有点dream quest味道的打牌游戏，画面不行，但玩法非常扎实。局外没有数值，只有各种成就解锁的卡牌、宠物、遗物。 多种关卡和隐藏BOSS做的挺有意思，最有趣的是combo机制，按combo顺序出牌能减费和强化卡牌效果。战斗采用了时序机制，出一张牌怪物时序减一，归零时采取行动，结束回合所有怪物时序减二，玩家重新抽牌。 爽点方面，某些遗物和道具的效果过于离谱(放弃选牌+10最大血量，SP+1和最大血量加100)，拿到就保送通关。删牌是百分比卖血删牌，根据提示多次删牌后能额外拿到一个遗物。由于可以多次删牌，做出强力构筑还是很简单的，战士就无脑堆攻防，法师各种元素左脚踩右脚循环，机械师=鸡煲启动中。 友情提示，洞穴关boss会每回合塞牌，玩无限华丽登场的别把卡组压缩的太极限，否则碰到必死。普难第四章太空boss 6000hp+1500hp+2000hp，一轮200-400攻，抓牌尽量搞攻防一体的方便配合指数增长卡。 打折30以下推荐试试

There's some interesting concepts here for a deckbuilder, especially if you can get it on sale, but it is currently rather rough around the edges and repetitive. A lot of numbers without a lot of weight to them. There's too many icons that you have to hover over and enemy intention could be communicated a lot better. The UI on the player side is a cluttered mess, especially playing the mage class, you'll have so many small symbols under your health bar, it's easy to forget what's what. I'd suggest the dev make the block score right of your health rather than a modifier icon, and class specific mechanisms, like the elements should get their own progress bars too. From a gameplay loop perspective, it would be nice if some mechanisms triggered more consistently or had some meta progression, maybe to initially hatch a pet I should have to go through the trouble of the spring water mechanism, but then there should be some meta progression that allows you to pick a pet to start. Otherwise it's an easily ignored gameplay feature.

Devs are pretty responsive, the game is a lot of fun, and the process of learning new secrets and tricks in the game actually adds a decent amount of interactivity. Would recommend, overall

I was enjoying this game a lot more until I got to a boss that just hard countered my deck. My run ended right there, because I had no way at all to do any damage to the boss. Even the Time Eater in Slay the Spire isn't that harsh.
Fun Roguelike deckbuilder with a lot of unique ways to play/do combos. The countdown mechanic gives the player a lot to think about. Would recommend.

The game's developer is active and has come a long way since I first started playing it. It's still pretty basic as a Slay the Spire clone with a lighter tone to it, but the game mechanics feel fresh in a meaningful way.

Novus Orbis is not only refreshing within the roguelike-ccg genre, and introduces a combo-mechanic that adds another layer of depth, it also is very well developed, and yet still in early access/active developement.

Excellent deck builder, enemy action count down stops the broken loop combo builds making it harder to break than other deckbuilding games. The combo meter impact as well further adds to the complexity so a fun game for people that enjoy managing multiple resources while still getting strong combinations and different styles of play across the characters.

Score: 3/5 It was boring and quite unpolished from my few tries at it in 2025 and mid 2026. I see potential for a decent game after Early Access, but doubt it will turn into something noteworthy. Audio/Music/SFX are okay. Music doesn't fit the more horror-themed creature battles. Gameplay is slow and moderately unintuitive, but with decent in-game pop-ups when hovering over the cards. Visuals are... okay . Some good creature designs, but combat animations are minimal/lacking/absent for most cards, with the player/creatures having some looping animations keeping me from fully disengaging mentally. Some mechanical balance issues. Got soft-locked in a battle because the game wouldn't complete an enemy's move, so I decided the game, after many updates, just wasn't worth playing at this stage in development, if ever.
